name: archify
description: Agent skill for beautiful, verifiable architecture, workflow, sequence, data-flow, and lifecycle diagrams—self-contained HTML with motion and crisp export.
one_liner: A tool that turns a code description into a polished, interactive diagram of how a system works, viewable right in the browser.
buyer: A tech lead or agency that has to produce architecture diagrams for client proposals and sprint reviews.
business_use_cases: A consulting agency auto-generates system architecture diagrams for every client statement of work or pitch deck.
A dev-tools startup bundles it into an 'explain this codebase' onboarding feature for new engineering hires.
A technical writer uses it to keep documentation diagrams in sync automatically as the underlying code changes.

money_ideas.idea: Package it as a CI step that auto-refreshes a team's architecture docs on every pull request.
Offer a one-off 'diagram your legacy codebase' service to teams with no up-to-date documentation.

steal_this: Wrap it in a GitHub Action that comments a fresh architecture diagram on every PR, and sell it as a paid add-on for teams onboarding new engineers.
